extracted.summary: The Chief Minister's Overseas Scholarship Scheme for Minorities, Telangana supports minority students pursuing postgraduate and doctoral studies abroad, offering up to INR 20,00,000 in financial assistance.
extracted.min_percentage_quote: Applicants must have secured at least 60% marks in the previous qualifying examination.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: Applicants must have a total annual family income from all sources of less than INR 5,00,000.
extracted.categories_quote: Applicants must belong to a minority community as notified by the Government.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be pursuing a PG or Ph.D. in the USA, UK, Australia, Canada, Japan, France, South Korea or Singapore.
extracted.states_quote: Applicants must be a domicile of Telangana.
extracted.min_age_quote: Applicants must be below 30 years of age as of July 1st of the application year.
